operating_contract.autonomy: Proceed autonomously with Step 8G and other technically resolvable non-public-runtime work. The parked Step 8F gate must not globally block Step 8G.
operating_contract.billing_firewall: Never authorize paid infrastructure or automatic overage. Free exhaustion must fail closed.
operating_contract.public_activation: Step 8F is parked. Do not activate, broaden or otherwise change normal public recommendation runtime until the owner explicitly reopens and approves Step 8F.
operating_contract.source_authority: Source nutrition, dietary/allergen claims and scaling rules remain non-authoritative unless separately admitted.

step8f.park_rule: Do not ask for an 8F decision merely because work continues. Resume 8F only when the owner explicitly asks to decide or activate public runtime.

step8g.objective: Continue rights-clean protected corpus expansion and measurement cohort by cohort while marginal coverage/quality value justifies it and existing no-billing/capacity/topology boundaries remain safe.

validation.note: A later github-actions[bot] terminal-freeze commit caused automatically triggered PR workflows to show action_required. The underlying Step 8E and browser checks had already passed. Reconcile and retrigger under the regular actor before merging PR #150.

If needed, use the regular connector-authored handover/state commit to retrigger CI after the prior bot-authored action_required state; do not change earned Step 8E evidence merely to satisfy CI.

Do not enter Step 8F or alter normal public recommendations unless the owner explicitly reopens Step 8F.

A security/account/secrets action requires the owner.
